groups.definition: Weaker-than-expected consumer adoption of electric vehicles, driven by infrastructure gaps, reduced incentives or relaxed regulation, may prevent profitable EV sales and cause charges.

groups.canonical_name: EV cost reduction and scaling execution
groups.definition: Failure to reduce battery costs, secure battery materials and scale EV manufacturing could cause losses and impair the EV strategy.
Acquisitions, divestitures, capital investments and restructuring may fail to deliver expected benefits or disrupt the business.
